text:
maria: FYI I found keystore-proxy making egress to an external telemetry host from the sealed VLAN. cluster=priv-eu1, ns=redwood-keystore.
raj: paste netpol + short flow?
maria: flow: ALLOW to 34.120.99.10:443 (telemetry.external). default-deny supposed to block.
olivia: sec-scan id s-2026-03-21-99 flagged metadata-fallback risk.
sec-bot: [AUTO] vuln-scan s-2026-03-21-99: privileged ns allowed unexpected external egress
ben: mitigation: patch netpol to explicit egress whitelist, restart pods. will open PR. also reduce keystore SA secrets scope.
maria: opening PR infra/k8s#8501 to add egress whitelist, add egress-negative test, and tighten RBAC for keystore SA. not changing KMS IAM until we have attestation in place.
raj: long term: require workload attestation for KMS Decrypt and include per-request requester metadata in decrypt audit logs.
olivia: audit plan: ship signed keystore audit to SIEM over mTLS; for air-gapped installs write signed bundles to WORM.
ben: triage checklist: rotate keys in staging, patch netpol to block 0.0.0.0/0, enable decrypt audit, run PoC exploit in staging.
maria: IR play: on external decrypt detect -> cut egress for ns, rotate keys, follow INC-priv-2026-046 runbook.
raj: owners: @olivia PR + canary deploy; @ben key rotation artifacts.
olivia: taking it; canary -> 15m monitor -> rollout at 17:00 CET.
ben: creating ENGOPS-333 and will attach rotation logs.
sec-bot: [AUTO] incident INC-2026-046 created
